name: [VULTURE] Bird Game
desc:
🪺 Bird Game 🪺

Do you have what it takes to build the ultimate nest? Collect eggs, hatch powerful birds, and defend what’s yours while stealing from others.

How To Play:

🥚 Collect Eggs that spawn around the map
🪺 Deposit Eggs into your nest to hatch new birds
🐣 Wait & Hatch eggs to unlock stronger birds
💰 Earn Money from your growing flock
🛡️ Buy Defenses & More Nest Slots
⚔️ Attack Other Players and steal their eggs
